== English errata comparison sources ==
The Limited and physical Revised faces use mandatory relocation at the end of the next turn. Appendix A in the 2022 and 2023 rulebooks and the complete D-E1 face say the Effect may be relocated at any time. They retain the restriction on attempting Jedi Tests through the end of the next turn. The pinned Players Committee Light.json record 157 uses the earlier relocation timing and says “any apprentice.” The comparison and the errata article follow the rulebooks and matching face.
